SYNTHETIC PARSER FIXTURE — NOT AN AUTHORITATIVE SOURCE SNAPSHOT

DEPARTMENT OF TRANSPORTATION

Airline Refunds and Other Consumer Protections

DATES: As of December 5, 2025, the Department is pausing until June 30, 2026.

The Department is announcing a limited exercise of enforcement discretion for the
renumbered-flight circumstances described in the notice until June 30, 2026. The
underlying refund requirements remain in effect.
